caption: The video captures a soft-focus grayscale view of a pale wall covered with blurred shadows of foliage—palm-like fronds and dense leafy masses—beneath a thin dark rectangular grid of window-pane lines. The frame stays hazy, with no sharp edges resolving into focus. Over the excerpt the shadow pattern drifts slowly: the dense dark mass at the centre-right slides toward the right, while brighter zones with more defined frond silhouettes emerge along the left. The thin grid lines remain stationary relative to the frame edges, providing a fixed reference against which the shadows translate. The change reads as a continuous sideways shift of the foliage pattern across the static grid. The soft defocus persists throughout, leaving the cause of the motion unresolved within this segment.
